source.title: Paul's ace: the send-out order at Lily of the Valley

summary: The approved Bulbapedia card set Paul's story ace to Torterra on a weak signal (the history names Torterra 5 times, Electivire 3). The send-out order is stronger evidence: Paul sent Electivire out last in his Lily of the Valley full battle against Ash, the slot a trainer saves for their ace (D-050). This puts Electivire back.

data.why: Bulbapedia, Paul's Electivire: 'Paul used it as his last Pokémon in his quarterfinal battle against Ash in Battling a Thaw in Relations!' Saved for last in the battle his version stands for; the mention count that picked Torterra was the weakest signal on that card.

claims.note: puts back the authored ace; reject it to keep Torterra
